plane: ViralTrac Event / Reactive Plane governed event/reaction plane

mode_behavior.off: Do not depend on event delivery; use scheduler/polling/manual fallback.
mode_behavior.publish_shadow: Treat the event fabric as observation infrastructure only; do not configure BusinessOS live reaction.
mode_behavior.evaluate_shadow: BusinessOS may receive/evaluate when a compatible delivery lane exists, but event-triggered external effects remain disabled.
mode_behavior.allowlisted_actions: Reactive evaluation is allowed; only separately eligible/authorized allowlisted actions may execute.
mode_behavior.broad: Use normal governed event-driven operation for supported BusinessOS event families, still respecting local materiality and action approval.
mode_behavior.degraded: Preserve critical evaluation and use fallback for optional/reactive work according to provider reason codes.

rules: ViralTrac owns occurrence truth, normalization, identity/policy enrichment, delivery/evaluation receipts, traces, replay governance, and provider/native effects.
BusinessOS owns business materiality, operating-process routing, domain Insights/Opportunities/Initiatives, and its own Action/OutcomeEvaluation/Learning objects.
Do not auto-activate live reactive delivery from route presence alone; require current operational-mode/readiness evidence and a compatible host delivery mechanism.
Preserve ViralTrac root/parent/trace identities and never generate a new independent BusinessOS cause chain when reacting to an echoed downstream consequence.
If live delivery is unavailable, keep equivalent monitoring intent through scheduled/polling/manual operation.
